home.title: System administration
home.description: Pick an item in the left menu to manage the system.

user.title: Account management
user.revokeConfirmContent: {{email}} will have to sign in again.

setting.title: System settings

app_frontend_base_url.label: Web app base URL
app_frontend_base_url.desc: Base URL of the web app used for links in emails

security_cors_allowed_origins.label: Allowed CORS origins
security_cors_allowed_origins.desc: Browser origins allowed to call the API

auth_jwt_access_ttl.label: Access token lifetime
auth_jwt_access_ttl.desc: Access token expires after this period

auth_jwt_refresh_ttl.label: Refresh token lifetime
auth_jwt_refresh_ttl.desc: Refresh token expires after this period

upload_max_file_size.label: Max file size
upload_max_file_size.desc: Size limit of a single uploaded file

upload_part_url_ttl.label: Part URL lifetime
upload_part_url_ttl.desc: Lifetime of the presigned URL for each file part

upload_session_idle_ttl.label: Upload session idle timeout
upload_session_idle_ttl.desc: Upload session expires after this idle period

upload_max_sessions_per_user.label: Max sessions per user
upload_max_sessions_per_user.desc: Maximum open upload sessions per user

upload_verify_etag_md5.label: Verify ETag MD5
upload_verify_etag_md5.desc: Verify ETag MD5 integrity when an upload completes

upload_session_hard_expiry.label: Upload session hard expiry
upload_session_hard_expiry.desc: Upload session is cancelled after this period even if active

upload_initial_url_batch.label: Initial URL batch
upload_initial_url_batch.desc: Number of part URLs issued when a session opens

upload_reconcile_orphan_min_age.label: Orphan minimum age
upload_reconcile_orphan_min_age.desc: Unlinked files are only cleaned when older than this

upload_reconcile_submit_window.label: Reconcile submit window
upload_reconcile_submit_window.desc: Window used to reconcile finished but unsubmitted uploads

upload_gc_interval.label: Upload GC interval
upload_gc_interval.desc: How often expired upload sessions are cleaned

download_url_ttl_min.label: Min download URL lifetime
download_url_ttl_min.desc: Minimum lifetime of a download URL

download_url_ttl_max.label: Max download URL lifetime
download_url_ttl_max.desc: Maximum lifetime of a download URL

proof_max_name_length.label: Max name length
proof_max_name_length.desc: Maximum characters of the proof submitter name

proof_max_note_length.label: Max note length
proof_max_note_length.desc: Maximum characters of the proof note

proof_max_submit_assets.label: Max assets per submission
proof_max_submit_assets.desc: Maximum assets in a single proof submission

proof_max_page_size.label: Max page size
proof_max_page_size.desc: Maximum records per page in proof lists

dashboard_recent_default_limit.label: Default recent items
dashboard_recent_default_limit.desc: Default number of recent items shown

dashboard_recent_max_limit.label: Max recent items
dashboard_recent_max_limit.desc: Maximum recent items that can be requested

retention_processing_jobs.label: Processing job retention
retention_processing_jobs.desc: Processing jobs are deleted after this period

retention_upload_sessions.label: Upload session retention
retention_upload_sessions.desc: Upload sessions are deleted after this period

job_max_retries.label: Max retries
job_max_retries.desc: Retries allowed for a job with a transient failure

job_backoff_max.label: Backoff max
job_backoff_max.desc: Upper bound of the delay between retries

job_presign_ttl.label: Job presign lifetime
job_presign_ttl.desc: Lifetime of presigned URLs workers use to fetch and return files

job_upload_batch_size.label: Upload batch size
job_upload_batch_size.desc: Files a worker uploads per batch

job_workspace_cleanup_age.label: Workspace cleanup age
job_workspace_cleanup_age.desc: Job temp folders older than this are cleaned

job_lease_duration.label: Lease duration
job_lease_duration.desc: How long a worker holds a job before renewing

job_poll_interval.label: Poll interval
job_poll_interval.desc: How often workers poll for new jobs

job_reaper_interval.label: Reaper interval
job_reaper_interval.desc: How often jobs with expired leases are reclaimed

job_relay_interval.label: Relay interval
job_relay_interval.desc: How often job results are relayed to Kafka

job_relay_lease.label: Relay lease
job_relay_lease.desc: How long a node holds the right to relay results

video_timeout.label: Video timeout
video_timeout.desc: A video job is cancelled after this period

video_probe_timeout.label: Video probe timeout
video_probe_timeout.desc: Maximum time to read video info

video_crf.label: Video quality (CRF)
video_crf.desc: Lower CRF means higher quality and larger files

video_preset.label: Video preset
video_preset.desc: Encoding speed preset; slower compresses better

image_processing_timeout.label: Image processing timeout
image_processing_timeout.desc: An image task is cancelled after this period

image_max_pixels.label: Max pixels
image_max_pixels.desc: Images above this pixel count are rejected

image_webp_effort.label: WebP effort
image_webp_effort.desc: WebP compression effort; higher is slower

image_preview_max_edge.label: Preview max edge
image_preview_max_edge.desc: Longest edge of preview images in pixels

raw_command_timeout.label: RAW command timeout
raw_command_timeout.desc: Maximum time for each RAW processing command

raw_lock_wait.label: RAW lock wait
raw_lock_wait.desc: Maximum time to wait for the RAW lock

mail_password.label: SMTP password
mail_password.desc: Mail server password, never shown again

mail_auth.label: SMTP authentication
mail_auth.desc: Authenticate when connecting to the mail server

mail_starttls.label: STARTTLS
mail_starttls.desc: Use STARTTLS to encrypt the connection

mail_connection_timeout.label: Connection timeout
mail_connection_timeout.desc: Maximum time to connect to the mail server

mail_timeout.label: Read timeout
mail_timeout.desc: Maximum time to wait for the mail server

mail_write_timeout.label: Write timeout
mail_write_timeout.desc: Maximum time to send data to the mail server

mail_from_address.label: Sender address
mail_from_address.desc: Sender email address; falls back to the SMTP username when empty

mail_from_name.label: Sender name
mail_from_name.desc: Display name of the email sender

setting.fixedHint: Core parameters owned by developers; administrators can only view them.

node.title: Workers / Nodes
node.empty: No node has sent a heartbeat yet. Check that services are running and can reach MongoDB.
node.drainConfirm: Drain this node? It stops taking new jobs; running jobs continue.
